research_goal: Quantify ACCOUNT-EXPOSURE sensitivity to selected frozen time-separated public displayed-depth marks during October 2025 stop crossing; no orders, no historical strategy rerun, no actual fills.
reference: Original static 4pct reference = filled_entry_price * .96; not a realized stop fill.
accounting: For each selected existing L2 static displayed 200-level bid-walk VWAP MARK, compute (MARK - static-stop-reference)*original BTC quantity in USDT and as percent of ORIGINAL cash_before_entry. Do not apply costs, size optimization or claim PnL. Snapshot age <=2000ms and zero top-book crossed and book continuity required, otherwise do not mark. Use decimals, no future candles, no alternative stop thresholds.
risk_budget_diagnostic: Show pure algebraic hypothetical quantity caps for a 1% or 2% of entry-time cash budget using entry-to-15-second static mark adverse distance only (without fee, realized fill or implementation). Do not recommend deploying either size from one historically seen event.
hard_limits: These are hypothetical MARK-TO-REFERENCE sensitivity figures from displayed third-party book at different times, not actual stop execution, slippage, market impact, portfolio simulation, 4h historical parity fix, forward evidence, or strategy profit. Liquidity may cancel before orders arrive; 15-second mark not a worst case.
